standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic communication and documents task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: Unlike sorting the paperwork for one appointment or one trip into a single folder, this task asks the learner to design a standing system the persona would keep running for as long as they live independently: a small set of ongoing document categories (such as housing, income and budget, health, and identification), a specific place each category lives (a drawer, a labeled folder, a digital folder), and a recurring habit, on a specific day each month, for reviewing and updating the whole system.

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Which document category is most likely to be forgotten during a busy month, and what about your system's design would catch that before it becomes a problem?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: System design (ongoing vs. single-event): At least four ongoing categories are named, each with a specific assigned storage location. | Recurring review habit: A specific recurring day and a clear checklist of review actions are given. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner design what happens to the system when one category outgrows its storage location (for example, income records piling up after a year), adding a specific rule for when and how the persona archives or discards old documents.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic communication and documents task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.elapsedWindow: Up to seven days; use only the check-ins explicitly named in the task
duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or a document
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: communication and documents action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for communication and documents.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: communication and documents coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Unlike sorting the paperwork for one appointment or one trip into a single folder, this task asks the learner to design a standing system the persona would keep running for as long as they live independently: a small set of ongoing document categories (such as housing, income and budget, health, and identification), a specific place each category lives (a drawer, a labeled folder, a digital folder), and a recurring habit, on a specific day each month, for reviewing and updating the whole system.
Coach direction: Before designing the system, distinguish it from a single-event folder.

Learner prompt: In your own words, explain the difference between organizing paperwork for one single event (like one doctor visit) and building an ongoing system the persona keeps running every month.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: communication and documents complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Name the ongoing document categories the system will track and where each one lives.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I named at least four ongoing document categories relevant to independent living (for example, housing, income and budget, health, identification).
Response 2 (t2-p2): I assigned a specific storage location to every category, not a vague 'somewhere safe.'
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: communication and documents minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Which document category is most likely to be forgotten during a busy month, and what about your system's design would catch that before it becomes a problem?

Success checks: System design (ongoing vs. single-event): At least four ongoing categories are named, each with a specific assigned storage location. | Recurring review habit: A specific recurring day and a clear checklist of review actions are given.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: communication and documents supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional communication and documents condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — System design (ongoing vs. single-event): At least four ongoing categories are named, each with a specific assigned storage location. | Recurring review habit: A specific recurring day and a clear checklist of review actions are given..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
